title: actinostachys tenuis
intro: Actinostachys tenuis, commonly known as New Zealand fern or Hinangi, is a type of plant that belongs to the family of Osmundaceae and is native to New Zealand and other Pacific Islands. It has been traditionally used in medicine for its various health benefits, which include treating digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and supporting immune function. The plant is known to exhibit therapeutic actions such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. Bioactive constituents present in Actinostachys tenuis include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
